result.summary: The main defect is the promotional banner: its white headline and subtext sit on a pale mint background and are nearly invisible, so users cannot read the offer or the promo code TALLINN3. Two lesser cosmetic issues were also found. The rest of the layout (header, search, chips, carousels, cards, bottom nav) renders correctly; the clipped carousel items and the partially visible pizza card are expected behavior.

issues.description: The promo banner's headline ('3 free deliveries for you') and subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') are white on a very light mint background. The contrast is far below WCAG minimums, making the text almost invisible. Users cannot read the offer or the promo code they need at checkout, while only the 'Order now' button is legible.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., the dark green or near-black used elsewhere) on the light background, or darken the banner background to a saturated green that supports white text. Aim for at least 4.5:1 contrast for body text.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below. The repetition adds clutter.
issues.suggestion: Keep the image badge for emphasis and drop the duplicate from the metadata row, or replace the badge with a different highlight (e.g., a promotion).

issues.description: On the Green Bowl Poké card, the white '15–25 min' badge sits on a very light grey image background. The badge has little visual separation, unlike the other cards, where it stands out against dark imagery.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle border or stronger shadow to the time badges, or use a slightly darker image or overlay so the badge stands out consistently across cards.
